                              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x' →
                                  S.moment (x + x') = S.moment x + S.moment x') →
                          (moment_homogeneous :
                              ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k),
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x → S.moment (r • x) = r • S.moment x) →
                            (kappa_slot_injective : Function.Injective S.kappaSlot) →

                                    Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →

                                (kappa_slot_free : ∀ (i j : Fin k), S.freeMap (S.kappaSlot i) j = 0) →
                                  (cell_bound :

                                          ∀ (ζ : Fin k → ℝ),

                                          Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →

                                            Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                                              ∀ (ζ : Fin k → ℝ),

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars},
  (∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.resolved ↔ -n ∈ S.resolved) →
    (∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.band ↔ -n ∈ S.band) →
      0 ∈ S.resolved →
        Disjoint S.resolved S.band →
          (K.IsAxis → S.resolved = {0}) →
            (∀ n ∉ S.resolved, 3 ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n) →
              0 < S.splitLength →
                (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                    p.1 ≠ 0 →
                      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                        inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u) u ≤
                          S.strainBound p * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                  ((∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                        (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => S.localMatrix n p i j) ∧
                          ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖S.localMatrix n p i j‖ ≤ C) ∧
                      (Measurable S.strainBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.strainBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                        (Measurable S.meanGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.meanGradBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                          Measurable S.waveGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.waveGradBound p| ≤ C) →
                    (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ S.meanGradBound p ∧ 0 ≤ S.waveGradBound p) →
                      (∀ (n : ℤ), 0 < S.energyWeight n) →
                        (∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                          (∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.vorticityWeight n) →
                            (∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                              (∀ (n : ℤ),
                                  S.energyWeight (-n) = S.energyWeight n ∧
                                    S.vorticityWeight (-n) = S.vorticityWeight n ∧
                                      S.curlAbsorb (-n) = S.curlAbsorb n ∧
                                        S.strainAbsorb (-n) = S.strainAbsorb n ∧
                                          S.velocityAbsorb (-n) = S.velocityAbsorb n ∧
                                            S.tailShift (-n) = S.tailShift n) →
                                (∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), (S.localMatrix n p).IsHermitian) →
                                  (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (S.localMatrix n p)
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α p s) →
                                    (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                            ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                0 ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                          S.pairLoss n p s v +
                                                        S.curlAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                      S.strainAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s +
                                                    S.velocityAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq v) →
                                      (∀ n ∉ S.resolved,
                                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                            p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                              ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnVec
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth c.order n) v =
                                                      fun a => ↑p.1 * s a 1) →
                                                    0 ≤
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α
                                                                  p s -
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss
                                                                  (S.strainBound p) (S.meanGradBound p)
                                                                  (S.waveGradBound p) S.splitLength s v -
                                                              if n ∈ S.band then 0 else S.penalty s v) +
                                                          S.curlAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                        S.strainAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s) →
                                        (∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.tailShift n) →
                                          (∀ n ∉ S.resolved, S.tailShift n = 0) →
                                            0 < S.weightFloor →
                                              (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                  n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                    S.weightFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧
                                                      S.symWeight n j l ≤
                                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j
                                                                  l +
                                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                                  max
                                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                          c.order n -
                                                                        2)
                                                                      0 ^
                                                                    2) -
                                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                                (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                    n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                      S.weightFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l ∧
                                                        S.antiWeight n j l ≤
                                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K
                                                                      j l +
                                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                                      max
                                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                              c.order n -
                                                                            1)
                                                                          0 ^
                                                                        2) -
                                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                                  (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      ∀ (j l : ℕ),
                                                        S.degHigh ≤ max j l →
                                                          S.weightFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l ∧
                                                            S.velWeight n j l ≤
                                                              (S.tailShift n *
                                                                  if S.degHigh ≤ j then
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                                                  else
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                                                S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                                    3 ≤ S.degLow ∧
                                                        S.degLow + 2 ≤ S.degHigh ∧ S.degHigh + 1 ≤ S.degNear →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S

                                    (energyWeight_le : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                                      (vorticityWeight_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.vorticityWeight n) →

                                            ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                                          (weights_symm :

                                                S.energyWeight (-n) = S.energyWeight n ∧

                                                        S.velocityAbsorb (-n) = S.velocityAbsorb n ∧
                                                          S.tailShift (-n) = S.tailShift n) →
                                            (localMatrix_selfAdjoint :
                                                ∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), (S.localMatrix n p).IsHermitian) →
                                              (localMatrix_le :
                                                  ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (S.localMatrix n p)
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α p
                                                            s) →
                                                (resolved_pointwise :
                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,

                                                          ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),

                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *

                                                                        n)
                                                                      v =
                                                                    fun a => ↑p.1 * s a 1) →
                                                                  0 ≤
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K
                                                                            p *
                                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm
                                                                                c α p s -
                                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss
                                                                                (S.strainBound p) (S.meanGradBound p)
                                                                                (S.waveGradBound p) S.splitLength s v -

                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +

                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s) →

                                                                      S.energyWeight n *
                                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                K j l +
                                                                              K.angularWeight n *
                                                                                max
                                                                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                                        c.order n -
                                                                                      2)
                                                                                    0 ^
                                                                                  2) -
                                                                          S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                                        S.tailShift n) →
                                                            (anti_weight :

                                                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                    K j l +
                                                                                  K.angularWeight n *
                                                                                    max
                                                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                                            c.order n -
                                                                                          1)
                                                                                        0 ^
                                                                                      2) -
                                                                              2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                                              (vel_weight :

                                                                      S.degHigh ≤ max j l →
                                                                        S.weightFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l ∧

                                                                                    K j

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {slots : ℕ}
  {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k},
  (∀ (μ : Fin N → ℝ),
      (∀ a ∉ R.rowSet, μ a = 0) →
        (∑ a ∈ R.rowSet, μ a ^ 2 / (4 * Real.pi * c.rowWeight a) + ∑ a ∈ R.rowSet, R.classRowWeight a * μ a ^ 2 +
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rowSquare c K S R B μ fun x x_1 => True) +
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rowSquareFar c K S R B μ / (1 - R.farShare) ≤
          ∑ a ∈ R.rowSet, ∑ b ∈ R.rowSet, μ a * R.multiplierMatrix a b * μ b) →
    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
          (∀ p ∈ K.rect,
              ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                c.weight (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) =
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p) →
            (∀ y ∈ K.solid,
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight y ≠ 0 →
                  c.modelVelocity (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror (c.modelVelocity y) ∧
                    c.modelCurl (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = -Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror (c.modelCurl y) ∧
                      (∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                          (c.modelStrain (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror ((c.modelStrain y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) ∧
                        (∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                            (c.modelCurlGrad (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                              -Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror ((c.modelCurlGrad y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) ∧
                          ∀ (i : Fin k),
                            (∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                (c.modelActuatorGrad i (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror
                                    ((c.modelActuatorGrad i y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) ∧
                              ∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                (c.modelPinField i (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror ((c.modelPinField i y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) →
              K.solid ⊆ c.cellRegion →
                (∀ (y u w : Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain y) u) w = inner ℝ u ((c.modelStrain y) w)) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.MemLp (c.modelActuator i) 2 MeasureTheory.volume) →
                    (∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                          ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                            ∑ i,
                                Breakdown.CellCert.entry
                                  (c.modelCurlGrad (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) i i =
                              0) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count),
                          Measurable (Cl.strainDev i) ∧
                            Measurable (Cl.gradDev i) ∧
                              Measurable (Cl.velocityDev i) ∧
                                Measurable (Cl.curlDev i) ∧
                                  ∃ C,
                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                      |Cl.strainDev i p| ≤ C ∧
                                        |Cl.gradDev i p| ≤ C ∧ |Cl.velocityDev i p| ≤ C ∧ |Cl.curlDev i p| ≤ C) →
                        (∀ n ∉ R.yModes,
                            ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                              p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelActuatorGrad i) p.1 p.2 =
                                      0 ∧
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelPinField i) p.1 p.2 = 0) →
                          (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet, ∀ y ∉ K.solid, c.row a y = 0) →
                            (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                                ∀ n ∉ R.rowModes,
                                  ∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rowMode c a n p = 0) →
                              (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                                  ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                    n ≠ R.rowModeOf a →
                                      n ≠ -R.rowModeOf a →
                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rowMode c a n p = 0) →
                                (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet, 0 < c.rowWeight a) →
                                  (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                      ∀ n' ∉ S.resolved ∪ S.band,
                                        (∃ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                            p.1 ≠ 0 ∧
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order (n - n') c.modelVelocity
                                                    p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                  0 ∨
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order (n - n') c.modelCurl p.1
                                                      p.2 ≠
                                                    0 ∨
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order (n - n') c.modelStrain
                                                        p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                      0 ∨
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order (n - n')
                                                        c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                      0)) →
                                          ∃ i, n - n' ∈ Cl.modes i) →
                                    (∀ (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                                          ∀ (ζ : Fin k → ℝ),
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.farWeighted c K S B x.2.2.2.1 ζ
                                                x.1 x.2.1 R ≤
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.farFormValue c K S R B x ζ) →

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars},
  (∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.resolved ↔ -n ∈ S.resolved) →
    (∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.band ↔ -n ∈ S.band) →
      0 ∈ S.resolved →
        Disjoint S.resolved S.band →
          (K.IsAxis → S.resolved = {0}) →
            (∀ n ∉ S.resolved, 3 ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n) →
              0 < S.splitLength →
                (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                    p.1 ≠ 0 →
                      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                        inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u) u ≤
                          S.strainBound p * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                  ((∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                        (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => S.localMatrix n p i j) ∧
                          ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖S.localMatrix n p i j‖ ≤ C) ∧
                      (Measurable S.strainBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.strainBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                        (Measurable S.meanGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.meanGradBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                          Measurable S.waveGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.waveGradBound p| ≤ C) →
                    (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ S.meanGradBound p ∧ 0 ≤ S.waveGradBound p) →
                      (∀ (n : ℤ), 0 < S.energyWeight n) →
                        (∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                          (∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.vorticityWeight n) →
                            (∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                              (∀ (n : ℤ),
                                  S.energyWeight (-n) = S.energyWeight n ∧
                                    S.vorticityWeight (-n) = S.vorticityWeight n ∧
                                      S.curlAbsorb (-n) = S.curlAbsorb n ∧
                                        S.strainAbsorb (-n) = S.strainAbsorb n ∧
                                          S.velocityAbsorb (-n) = S.velocityAbsorb n ∧
                                            S.tailShift (-n) = S.tailShift n) →
                                (∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), (S.localMatrix n p).IsHermitian) →
                                  (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (S.localMatrix n p)
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α p s) →
                                    (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                            ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                0 ≤
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                          S.pairLoss n p s v +
                                                        S.curlAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                      S.strainAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s +
                                                    S.velocityAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq v) →
                                      (∀ n ∉ S.resolved,
                                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                            p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                              ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnVec
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth c.order n) v =
                                                      fun a => ↑p.1 * s a 1) →
                                                    0 ≤
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α
                                                                  p s -
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss
                                                                  (S.strainBound p) (S.meanGradBound p)
                                                                  (S.waveGradBound p) S.splitLength s v -
                                                              if n ∈ S.band then 0 else S.penalty s v) +
                                                          S.curlAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                        S.strainAbsorb n * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s) →
                                        (∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.tailShift n) →
                                          (∀ n ∉ S.resolved, S.tailShift n = 0) →
                                            0 < S.weightFloor →
                                              (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                  n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                    S.weightFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧
                                                      S.symWeight n j l ≤
                                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j
                                                                  l +
                                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                                  max
                                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                          c.order n -
                                                                        2)
                                                                      0 ^
                                                                    2) -
                                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                                (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                    n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                      S.weightFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l ∧
                                                        S.antiWeight n j l ≤
                                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K
                                                                      j l +
                                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                                      max
                                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                              c.order n -
                                                                            1)
                                                                          0 ^
                                                                        2) -
                                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                                  (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      ∀ (j l : ℕ),
                                                        S.degHigh ≤ max j l →
                                                          S.weightFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l ∧
                                                            S.velWeight n j l ≤
                                                              (S.tailShift n *
                                                                  if S.degHigh ≤ j then
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                                                  else
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                                                S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                                    3 ≤ S.degLow ∧
                                                        S.degLow + 2 ≤ S.degHigh ∧ S.degHigh + 1 ≤ S.degNear →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars.casesOn
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
      {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
        {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S) →
              ((resolved_symm : ∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.resolved ↔ -n ∈ S.resolved) →
                  (band_symm : ∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.band ↔ -n ∈ S.band) →
                    (zero_resolved : 0 ∈ S.resolved) →
                      (disjoint : Disjoint S.resolved S.band) →
                        (axis_resolved : K.IsAxis → S.resolved = {0}) →
                          (unresolved_large :
                              ∀ n ∉ S.resolved, 3 ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n) →
                            (splitLength_pos : 0 < S.splitLength) →
                              (strain_le :
                                  ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                    p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                        inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
                                            u ≤
                                          S.strainBound p * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                (data_regular :
                                    (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                        (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => S.localMatrix n p i j) ∧
                                          ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖S.localMatrix n p i j‖ ≤ C) ∧
                                      (Measurable S.strainBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.strainBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                                        (Measurable S.meanGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.meanGradBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                                          Measurable S.waveGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.waveGradBound p| ≤ C) →
                                  (grad_bounds_nonneg : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ S.meanGradBound p ∧ 0 ≤ S.waveGradBound p) →
                                    (energyWeight_pos : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 < S.energyWeight n) →
                                      (energyWeight_le : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                                        (vorticityWeight_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.vorticityWeight n) →
                                          (vorticityWeight_le :
                                              ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                                            (weights_symm :
                                                ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                                  S.energyWeight (-n) = S.energyWeight n ∧
                                                    S.vorticityWeight (-n) = S.vorticityWeight n ∧
                                                      S.curlAbsorb (-n) = S.curlAbsorb n ∧
                                                        S.strainAbsorb (-n) = S.strainAbsorb n ∧
                                                          S.velocityAbsorb (-n) = S.velocityAbsorb n ∧
                                                            S.tailShift (-n) = S.tailShift n) →
                                              (localMatrix_selfAdjoint :
                                                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), (S.localMatrix n p).IsHermitian) →
                                                (localMatrix_le :
                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (S.localMatrix n p)
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α
                                                              p s) →
                                                  (resolved_pointwise :
                                                      ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                            ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                                0 ≤
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                                          S.pairLoss n p s v +
                                                                        S.curlAbsorb n *
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                                      S.strainAbsorb n *
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s +
                                                                    S.velocityAbsorb n *
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq v) →
                                                    (unresolved_pointwise :
                                                        ∀ n ∉ S.resolved,
                                                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                            p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                              ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnVec
                                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth c.order
                                                                          n)
                                                                        v =
                                                                      fun a => ↑p.1 * s a 1) →
                                                                    0 ≤
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K
                                                                              p *
                                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm
                                                                                  c α p s -
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss
                                                                                  (S.strainBound p) (S.meanGradBound p)
                                                                                  (S.waveGradBound p) S.splitLength s
                                                                                  v -
                                                                              if n ∈ S.band then 0 else S.penalty s v) +
                                                                          S.curlAbsorb n *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                                        S.strainAbsorb n *
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s) →
                                                      (tailShift_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.tailShift n) →
                                                        (tailShift_zero : ∀ n ∉ S.resolved, S.tailShift n = 0) →
                                                          (weightFloor_pos : 0 < S.weightFloor) →
                                                            (sym_weight :
                                                                ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                                  n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                                    S.weightFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧
                                                                      S.symWeight n j l ≤
                                                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                  K j l +
                                                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                                                  max
                                                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                                          c.order n -
                                                                                        2)
                                                                                      0 ^
                                                                                    2) -
                                                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                                              (anti_weight :
                                                                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                                    n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                                      S.weightFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l ∧
                                                                        S.antiWeight n j l ≤
                                                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                      K j l +
                                                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                                                      max
                                                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                                              c.order n -
                                                                                            1)
                                                                                          0 ^
                                                                                        2) -
                                                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                                                (vel_weight :
                                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                                      ∀ (j l : ℕ),
                                                                        S.degHigh ≤ max j l →
                                                                          S.weightFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l ∧
                                                                            S.velWeight n j l ≤
                                                                              (S.tailShift n *
                                                                                  if S.degHigh ≤ j then
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen
                                                                                      K j
                                                                                  else
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen
                                                                                      K l) -
                                                                                S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                                                  (degrees :
                                                                      3 ≤ S.degLow ∧
                                                                        S.degLow + 2 ≤ S.degHigh ∧
                                                                          S.degHigh + 1 ≤ S.degNear) →
                                                                    motive ⋯) →
                motive t

      {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
        {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S) →
              ((resolved_symm : ∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.resolved ↔ -n ∈ S.resolved) →
                  (band_symm : ∀ (n : ℤ), n ∈ S.band ↔ -n ∈ S.band) →
                    (zero_resolved : 0 ∈ S.resolved) →
                      (disjoint : Disjoint S.resolved S.band) →
                        (axis_resolved : K.IsAxis → S.resolved = {0}) →
                          (unresolved_large :
                              ∀ n ∉ S.resolved, 3 ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n) →
                            (splitLength_pos : 0 < S.splitLength) →
                              (strain_le :
                                  ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                    p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                      ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                        inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
                                            u ≤
                                          S.strainBound p * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                (data_regular :
                                    (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                        (∀ (i j : Fin 12), Measurable fun p => S.localMatrix n p i j) ∧
                                          ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, ∀ (i j : Fin 12), ‖S.localMatrix n p i j‖ ≤ C) ∧
                                      (Measurable S.strainBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.strainBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                                        (Measurable S.meanGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.meanGradBound p| ≤ C) ∧
                                          Measurable S.waveGradBound ∧ ∃ C, ∀ p ∈ K.rect, |S.waveGradBound p| ≤ C) →
                                  (grad_bounds_nonneg : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), 0 ≤ S.meanGradBound p ∧ 0 ≤ S.waveGradBound p) →
                                    (energyWeight_pos : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 < S.energyWeight n) →
                                      (energyWeight_le : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                                        (vorticityWeight_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.vorticityWeight n) →
                                          (vorticityWeight_le :
                                              ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                                            (weights_symm :
                                                ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                                  S.energyWeight (-n) = S.energyWeight n ∧
                                                    S.vorticityWeight (-n) = S.vorticityWeight n ∧
                                                      S.curlAbsorb (-n) = S.curlAbsorb n ∧
                                                        S.strainAbsorb (-n) = S.strainAbsorb n ∧
                                                          S.velocityAbsorb (-n) = S.velocityAbsorb n ∧
                                                            S.tailShift (-n) = S.tailShift n) →
                                              (localMatrix_selfAdjoint :
                                                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), (S.localMatrix n p).IsHermitian) →
                                                (localMatrix_le :
                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sesqValue (S.localMatrix n p)
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.pairVec s v) ≤
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm c α
                                                              p s) →
                                                  (resolved_pointwise :
                                                      ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                            ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                                0 ≤
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p *
                                                                          S.pairLoss n p s v +
                                                                        S.curlAbsorb n *
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                                      S.strainAbsorb n *
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s +
                                                                    S.velocityAbsorb n *
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq v) →
                                                    (unresolved_pointwise :
                                                        ∀ n ∉ S.resolved,
                                                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                                            p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                              ∀ (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (v : Fin 3 → ℂ),
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsTraceFree s →
                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.turnVec
                                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth c.order
                                                                          n)
                                                                        v =
                                                                      fun a => ↑p.1 * s a 1) →
                                                                    0 ≤
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K
                                                                              p *
                                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.densityForm
                                                                                  c α p s -
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.supremumLoss
                                                                                  (S.strainBound p) (S.meanGradBound p)
                                                                                  (S.waveGradBound p) S.splitLength s
                                                                                  v -
                                                                              if n ∈ S.band then 0 else S.penalty s v) +
                                                                          S.curlAbsorb n *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlSq s +
                                                                        S.strainAbsorb n *
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.sumSq s) →
                                                      (tailShift_nonneg : ∀ (n : ℤ), 0 ≤ S.tailShift n) →
                                                        (tailShift_zero : ∀ n ∉ S.resolved, S.tailShift n = 0) →
                                                          (weightFloor_pos : 0 < S.weightFloor) →
                                                            (sym_weight :
                                                                ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                                  n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                                    S.weightFloor ≤ S.symWeight n j l ∧
                                                                      S.symWeight n j l ≤
                                                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                  K j l +
                                                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                                                  max
                                                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                                          c.order n -
                                                                                        2)
                                                                                      0 ^
                                                                                    2) -
                                                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                                              (anti_weight :
                                                                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                                                    n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max j l →
                                                                      S.weightFloor ≤ S.antiWeight n j l ∧
                                                                        S.antiWeight n j l ≤
                                                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                                      K j l +
                                                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                                                      max
                                                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber
                                                                                              c.order n -
                                                                                            1)
                                                                                          0 ^
                                                                                        2) -
                                                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                                                (vel_weight :
                                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                                      ∀ (j l : ℕ),
                                                                        S.degHigh ≤ max j l →
                                                                          S.weightFloor ≤ S.velWeight n j l ∧
                                                                            S.velWeight n j l ≤
                                                                              (S.tailShift n *
                                                                                  if S.degHigh ≤ j then
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen
                                                                                      K j
                                                                                  else
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen
                                                                                      K l) -
                                                                                S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                                                  (degrees :

declarations.type:

  [inst : Fintype D] →
    [inst_1 : DecidableEq D] →
      {modes : Finset ℤ} →
        {Q q : ℕ} →
          {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
            {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
              {I : Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.LowIndex D modes Q q} →
                {m : ℕ} →
                  {v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} →
                    {G : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
                      {H : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} →
                        {u : D → ℂ} →
                          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.Represents K B I m v G H u → Sort u} →
                            (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.Represents K B I m v G H u) →
                              ((strain :
                                    ∀ (n : ↥modes) (a b : Fin 3) (j l : Fin (Q + 1)),
                                      u (I.strainSlot n a b j l) =
                                        B.coef K (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m (↑n) G a b) ↑j ↑l) →
                                  (velocity :
                                      ∀ (n : ↥modes) (a : Fin 3) (j l : Fin Q),
                                        u (I.velocitySlot n a j l) =
                                          B.coef K (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec m (↑n) v p.1 p.2 a)
                                            ↑j ↑l) →
                                    (radial_face :
                                        ∀ (n : ↥modes) (e : Fin 2) (a b : Fin 3) (l : Fin (q + 1)),
                                          (e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.rowApply (I.radialFaceRow n e a b l) u =
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.radialFaceMoment K
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m (↑n) G a b)
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialGradMode m (↑n) H a b) e
                                                (B.heightPoly ↑l)) →
                                      (height_face :
                                          ∀ (n : ↥modes) (e : Fin 2) (a b : Fin 3) (j : Fin (q + 1)),
                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.rowApply (I.heightFaceRow n e a b j) u =
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.heightFaceMoment K
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m (↑n) G a b)
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightGradMode m (↑n) H a b) e
                                                (B.radialPoly ↑j)) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {slots : ℕ}
  {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellScalars α c K S →
      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
        (∀ p ∈ K.rect,
            ∀ (θ : ℝ),
              c.weight (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2) =
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p) →
          (∀ y ∈ K.solid,
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylHeight y ≠ 0 →
                c.modelVelocity (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror (c.modelVelocity y) ∧
                  c.modelCurl (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y) = -Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror (c.modelCurl y) ∧
                    (∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                        (c.modelStrain (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror ((c.modelStrain y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) ∧
                      (∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                          (c.modelCurlGrad (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                            -Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror ((c.modelCurlGrad y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) ∧
                        ∀ (i : Fin k),
                          (∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                              (c.modelActuatorGrad i (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror
                                  ((c.modelActuatorGrad i y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) ∧
                            ∀ (u : Breakdown.Space),
                              (c.modelPinField i (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror y)) u =
                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror ((c.modelPinField i y) (Breakdown.SteadyCert.mirror u))) →
            K.solid ⊆ c.cellRegion →
              (∀ (y u w : Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ ((c.modelStrain y) u) w = inner ℝ u ((c.modelStrain y) w)) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.MemLp (c.modelActuator i) 2 MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2)
                          (S.meanGradBound p)) →
                    (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                          ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                              (fun a b =>
                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameMat θ
                                      (c.modelCurlGrad (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) a b) -
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2 a b)
                              (S.waveGradBound p)) →
                      (∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                            ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                              ∑ i,
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.entry
                                    (c.modelCurlGrad (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) i i =
                                0) →
                        (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count),
                            Measurable (Cl.strainDev i) ∧
                              Measurable (Cl.gradDev i) ∧
                                Measurable (Cl.velocityDev i) ∧
                                  Measurable (Cl.curlDev i) ∧
                                    ∃ C,
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                        |Cl.strainDev i p| ≤ C ∧
                                          |Cl.gradDev i p| ≤ C ∧ |Cl.velocityDev i p| ≤ C ∧ |Cl.curlDev i p| ≤ C) →
                          S.resolved ∪ S.band ⊆ R.yModes →
                            (∀ n ∉ R.yModes,
                                ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                  p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                    ∀ (i : Fin k),
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelActuatorGrad i) p.1
                                            p.2 =
                                          0 ∧
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order n (c.modelPinField i) p.1 p.2 =
                                          0) →
                              (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet, ∀ y ∉ K.solid, c.row a y = 0) →
                                (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                                    ∀ n ∉ R.rowModes,
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rowMode c a n p = 0) →
                                  (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                                      ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                        n ≠ R.rowModeOf a →
                                          n ≠ -R.rowModeOf a →
                                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rowMode c a n p = 0) →
                                    (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet, R.rowModeOf a ∈ S.resolved) →
                                      (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet, 0 < c.rowWeight a) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count) (n : ℤ), n ∈ Cl.modes i ↔ -n ∈ Cl.modes i) →
                                          (∀ (i j : Fin Cl.count), i ≠ j → Disjoint (Cl.modes i) (Cl.modes j)) →
                                            (∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                ∀ n' ∉ S.resolved ∪ S.band,
                                                  (∃ p ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                                                      p.1 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order (n - n')
                                                              c.modelVelocity p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                            0 ∨
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec c.order (n - n')
                                                                c.modelCurl p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                              0 ∨
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order (n - n')
                                                                  c.modelStrain p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                                0 ∨
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order (n - n')
                                                                  c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2 ≠
                                                                0)) →
                                                    ∃ i, n - n' ∈ Cl.modes i) →
                                              (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count), Cl.resolvedPart i ⊆ S.resolved) →
                                                (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count),
                                                    ∀ n ∈ S.resolved,
                                                      (∃ n' ∉ S.resolved ∪ S.band, n - n' ∈ Cl.modes i) →
                                                        n ∈ Cl.resolvedPart i) →
                                                  (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count), 0 < Cl.shareWeight i ∧ 0 < Cl.rowWeight i) →
                                                    (∀ (i : Fin Cl.count),

      (G : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (μ : Fin N → ℝ) (σ : ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ)
      (τ : ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin 3 → ℂ),

        (Summable fun jl =>
            if S.degNear < max jl.1 jl.2 then

                  if n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.symSq fun a b =>
                          B.coef K (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.yFolded c K S κ ζ v G n p a b)
                            jl.1 jl.2) /
                        S.symWeight n jl.1 jl.2 +
                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.antiSq fun a b =>
                          B.coef K (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.yFolded c K S κ ζ v G n p a b)
                            jl.1 jl.2) /
                        S.antiWeight n jl.1 jl.2
                  else 0) +
                ∑ n ∈ S.resolved,
                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq fun a =>
                      B.coef K (fun p => Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.yVelocity c K S v G n p a) jl.1
                        jl.2) /
                    S.velWeight n jl.1 jl.2

              if S.degNear < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                ∑ n' ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band,
                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sigmaWeightedPair
                        (fun i q =>
                          ∑ a ∈ R.rowSet,

                              B.coef K
                                (fun p =>

                  ∑ n' ∈ S.resolved,
                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq fun i =>
                        ∑ a ∈ R.rowSet,

                            B.coef K

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {slots : ℕ}
  {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N slots k},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellData α c K S B Cl R →
    ∀ (μ : Fin N → ℝ) (κ ζ : Fin k → ℝ) (v : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
      (G : Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space) (σ : ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ)
      (τ : ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin 3 → ℂ) (Y W : ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (Yv Wv : ℤ → ℕ → ℕ → Fin 3 → ℂ),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.targetStrain c K S R B μ κ ζ v G n j l = fun i q =>
            Y n j l i q + if n ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band then W n j l i q else 0) →
        (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.targetVelocity c K S R B μ v G n j l = fun i =>
              Yv n j l i + Wv n j l i) →
          (Summable fun jl =>
              if S.degNear < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                ∑ n ∈ R.yModes,
                    (S.symWeight n jl.1 jl.2 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.symSq (σ n jl.1 jl.2) +
                      S.antiWeight n jl.1 jl.2 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.antiSq (σ n jl.1 jl.2)) +
                  ∑ n ∈ S.resolved, S.velWeight n jl.1 jl.2 * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq (τ n jl.1 jl.2)
              else 0) →
            (Summable fun jl =>
                if S.degNear < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                  (∑ n ∈ R.yModes,
                      if n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.symSq (Y n jl.1 jl.2) / S.symWeight n jl.1 jl.2 +
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.antiSq (Y n jl.1 jl.2) / S.antiWeight n jl.1 jl.2
                      else 0) +
                    ∑ n ∈ S.resolved, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq (Yv n jl.1 jl.2) / S.velWeight n jl.1 jl.2
                else 0) →
              (Summable fun jl =>
                  if S.degNear < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                    (∑ n ∈ S.resolved ∪ S.band,
                        if n ∉ S.resolved ∨ S.degHigh < max jl.1 jl.2 then
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.symSq (W n jl.1 jl.2) / S.symWeight n jl.1 jl.2 +
                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.antiSq (W n jl.1 jl.2) / S.antiWeight n jl.1 jl.2
                        else 0) +
                      ∑ n ∈ S.resolved, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq (Wv n jl.1 jl.2) / S.velWeight n jl.1 jl.2
                  else 0) →
                Summable (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sharpFarTerm c K S R B μ κ ζ v G σ τ)

declarations.type:
∀ (rc hc : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ) (lw : ℝ → ℝ),
  (∀ (j : ℕ), rc j j ≠ 0) →
    (∀ (j : ℕ), hc j j ≠ 0) →
      Continuous lw →
        (∀ (j j' : ℕ),
            ∫ (r : ℝ) in Set.Icc a₁ a₂,
                lw r * Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.triPoly rc j r *
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.triPoly rc j' r =
              if j = j' then 1 else 0) →
          (∀ (l l' : ℕ),
              ∫ (z : ℝ) in Set.Icc b₁ b₂,
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.triPoly hc l z *
                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.triPoly hc l' z =
                if l = l' then 1 else 0) →
            ∀ (Q : ℕ) (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ),
              (∀ (t s : ℝ → ℝ),
                  Continuous t →
                    Continuous s →
                      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => ↑(lw p.1 * t p.1 * s p.2) * F p)
                        (Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                ∀ T ∈ Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.polyFnG Q Q,
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.pairOnG (Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc b₁ b₂) (fun p => lw p.1)
                      (fun p =>
                        F p -
                          ∑ j,
                            ∑ l,
                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.coefG rc hc a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ lw F ↑j ↑l *
                                ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellEnergy.HeightProj.bas rc hc (↑j) (↑l) p))
                      T =
                    0
