declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsAdjointDualStructure.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N} {j : Fin k} {p : Fin k → ℝ}
  {D : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.AdjointDual k},
  Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (d.adjoint j p) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.adjointGrad MeasureTheory.volume →
      Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsAdjointRegular (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad D.adjointSecond →
        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (fun y => d.splitVisc • d.adjoint j p y + d.adjointSharp j p y)
            D.sharpTrace →
          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.sharpTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              MeasureTheory.MemLp (d.adjointSharp j p) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf (d.adjointSharp j p) D.sharpGrad ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.sharpGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.sharpGrad y))
                      MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ (l : Fin k),
                ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.pinPotential l) ∧
                  HasCompactSupport (D.pinPotential l) ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (D.pinSecond l) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakSecondDerivOf (fun y => fderiv ℝ (D.pinPotential l) y)
                          (D.pinSecond l) ∧
                        (∃ C, ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖D.pinSecond l y‖ ≤ C) ∧
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf (D.pinPotential l) (D.pinTrace l) ∧
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (D.pinTrace l) MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                              ∃ C, ∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖D.pinTrace l y‖ ≤ C) →
              (∀ (l : Fin k) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                  d.smoothPin l y = (1 / D.pinScale l) • fderiv ℝ (D.pinPotential l) y) →
                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakScalarGradientOf D.pressure D.pressureGrad →
                  MeasureTheory.MemLp D.pressure 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                      MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.pressureGrad y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf D.dualField D.dualTrace →
                      MeasureTheory.MemLp D.dualField 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.dualTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf D.dualField D.dualGrad ∧
                              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.dualGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.dualGrad y))
                                  MeasureTheory.volume →
                        Breakdown.SteadyCert.IsWeakGradientOf D.potentialField D.potentialGrad →
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakNegTraceOf D.potentialField D.potentialTrace →
                            MeasureTheory.MemLp D.potentialField 2 MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.potentialGrad MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.potentialGrad y))
                                      MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.potentialTrace y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeakMatrixDivergenceOf D.fluxField D.fluxDiv →
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.fluxField MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (D.fluxField y))
                                        MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                      MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.fluxDiv y) 2 MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  (∀ᵐ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      D.remainderField α d j p y =
                                        D.inverseSquarePart y +
                                          ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ \ D.exactSet,
                                            p i •
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.convectionAdjointField (D.shiftField i)
                                                (D.shiftGrad i) (d.adjoint j p) D.adjointGrad y) →
                                    (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                        ContDiff ℝ 1 (D.shiftField i) ∧
                                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), D.shiftGrad i y = fderiv ℝ (D.shiftField i) y) ∧
                                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (D.shiftField i) y = 0) ∧
                                              ∃ C,
                                                ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                  ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖)⁻¹ ∧
                                                    ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ≤ C * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2)) →
                                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable D.inverseSquarePart MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => ‖y‖ • D.inverseSquarePart y) 2
                                            MeasureTheory.volume →
                                        (∀ k_1 ∉ D.inverseSquareModes,
                                            ∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.angularMode
                                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalPart D.inverseSquarePart)
                                                    k_1 ρ z =
                                                  0 ∧
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.angularMode
                                                    (Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.verticalPart D.inverseSquarePart) k_1
                                                    ρ z =
                                                  0) →
                                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                              MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                  (fun y => ‖D.shiftField i y‖ ^ 2 * ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2)
                                                  MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                                                  (fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2 * ‖D.shiftGrad i y‖ ^ 2 * ‖d.adjoint j p y‖ ^ 2)
                                                  MeasureTheory.volume) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsCellCoords.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N}
  {K₂ : Fin Sp.cellCount} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {Cl : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellClasses} {R : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellRows N Sp.slots k}
  {C : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.CellCoords k Sp.slots},
  0 < c.splitVisc →
    C.given.IsSymm →
      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B C.layout →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellParam C.layout C.param C.selection →
          (∀ (d : C.layout.Datum),
              (d ∈ C.param.skeleton ↔ C.layout.conjDatum d ∈ C.param.skeleton) ∧
                (d ∈ C.param.solvedSet ↔ C.layout.conjDatum d ∈ C.param.solvedSet)) →
            Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsRowShape c K S R →
              (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                  ∀ (s : Fin C.layout.segCount) (n : ℤ) (i : Fin 3),
                    ∃ Pl,
                      (∃ cf, ∀ (t : ℝ), Pl t = ∑ d, cf d * ↑((C.layout.segment s).test (↑d) t)) ∧
                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                          ((C.layout.segment s).radial = true →
                              p.1 = (C.layout.segment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i = Pl p.2) ∧
                            (¬(C.layout.segment s).radial = true →
                              p.2 = (C.layout.segment s).level →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p i = Pl p.1)) →
                (∀ a ∈ R.rowSet,
                    ∀ (s : Fin C.layout.presCount) (n : ℤ),
                      ∃ Pl,
                        (∃ cf, ∀ (t : ℝ), Pl t = ∑ d, cf d * ↑((C.layout.presSegment s).test (↑d) t)) ∧
                          ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                            ((C.layout.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                p.1 = (C.layout.presSegment s).level →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 0 = Pl p.2) ∧
                              (¬(C.layout.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                p.2 = (C.layout.presSegment s).level →
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.rowModeVec c a n p 2 = Pl p.1)) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsGaugeSpec C.layout C.gaugeSpec →
                    (∀ (x y : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k) (a b : ℝ),
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                          Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c y →
                            C.gaugeLeft (a • x + b • y) = a * C.gaugeLeft x + b * C.gaugeLeft y ∧
                              C.gaugeRight (a • x + b • y) = a * C.gaugeRight x + b * C.gaugeRight y) →
                      (∀ (e : Fin C.layout.presCount × Fin C.layout.degSide),
                          C.gaugeSpec.edge = some e →
                            ∀ (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k),
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                                C.gaugeRight x = C.gaugeLeft x + C.layout.gaugeJump C.gaugeSpec x) →
                        (∀ r ∈ C.gaugeSpec.roots,
                            ∀ (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k),
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                                C.layout.rootShifted C.gaugeLeft C.gaugeRight x r = 0) →
                          (∀ (x : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.FieldTuple k),
                              Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.IsAdmissible c x →
                                ∀
                                  (j :
                                    Fin
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords C.layout C.param).card),
                                  ∑ i, C.Tmap j i * Sp.moment x i =
                                    C.layout.realPart
                                        (C.layout.shiftedData (C.layout.gaugeShiftOf C.gaugeLeft C.gaugeRight) x)
                                        ↑((Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords C.layout
                                                  C.param).equivFin.symm
                                            j) /
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.presetScale C.layout c.splitVisc
                                        (↑((Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords C.layout
                                                    C.param).equivFin.symm
                                              j)).1) →
                            (∀ (j : Fin (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords C.layout C.param).card)
                                (i : Fin k), ∑ l, C.Tmap j l * Sp.freeMap l i = 0) →
                              (∀ (w : Fin Sp.slots ⊕ Fin k → ℝ),
                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue (Sp.cellMatrix K₂) w ≤
                                    4 * Real.pi * c.splitVisc *
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue C.given
                                        (C.restrictState c.splitVisc Sp.kappaSlot w)) →
                                R.farSupport ⊆ Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.lowSupport S →
                                  (∀
                                      (s :
                                        Fin
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords C.layout
                                                C.param).card →
                                          ℝ)
                                      (ξ :
                                        Fin
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemInteriorCoords C.layout
                                                C.param).card →
                                          ℝ)
                                      (κ' ζ' : Fin k → ℝ),
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue C.given (Sum.elim s (Sum.elim κ' ζ')) ≤
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.Finite.quadValue
                                          ((C.formula c K S B Cl R α).exactFormula c K B R)
                                          (Sum.elim
                                            (fun i =>
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.expandedCoords C.layout C.param
                                                c.splitVisc s ξ (Sum.inl i))
                                            (Sum.elim
                                              (fun j =>
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.expandedCoords C.layout C.param
                                                  c.splitVisc s ξ (Sum.inr j))
                                              (Sum.elim κ' ζ')))) →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsCellCoords α c Sp K₂ K S B Cl R C
